name: Puerto Rico
famous_for: Historic Old San Juan cobblestones, El Yunque National Forest (only US tropical rainforest), bioluminescent bays, and Salsa music.
tourists: Over 5.0M visitors; famous for Castillo San Felipe del Morro, Flamenco Beach in Culebra, and Mosquito Bioluminescent Bay.
must_know: Puerto Rico is the birthplace of the Piña Colada cocktail, created in Old San Juan in the 1950s.
fun_fact: Mosquito Bay on Vieques island is recognized by Guinness as the brightest bioluminescent bay on Earth, illuminated by dinoflagellates.
